messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall for high egress error rate in eu-west-2 (AZ d). Alert: `egress-error-rate > 10%` across multiple endpoints. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/9876
Maria (oncall): Acked. I'm taking triage. Can someone from netops confirm if any recent route/NAT changes in eu-west-2?
Ashok (netops): Looking. I'm seeing a route update at ~3301234300 where rtb-0a1b2c3d had its 0.0.0.0/0 target flipped from `nat-abc123` (az-d) -> `nat-def456` (az-b). That would cause asymmetric return for instances pinned to az-d.
Jamie (sre): That would explain TCP resets + timeouts. Are customers hitting our internal egress proxies or directly to third party?
Alex (support): Support telemetry shows ~12 customers with outbound API failures (post-2026-03-15T09:05Z). Errors: 502/503 from our proxy and connection resets from app hosts. Tickets: #C-9932, #C-9933.
Maria (oncall): Can we re-point the route back to nat-abc123? If that's not possible, fail over to the backup NAT in az-d (nat-backup-789). Prioritize customer egress.
Ashok (netops): Agree. I can run the route replace. Plan: 1) replace-route on rtb-0a1b2c3d -> nat-abc123; 2) confirm conntrack and NAT path. Executing now.
Ashok (netops): ```bash
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-abc123 --region eu-west-2
```
Ashok (netops): done. Route update returned "ReplaceRoute: succeeded" at 3301234445.
Jamie (sre): I'll tail the proxy metrics and connection timeouts. Watching for recovery sliding window.
Alex (support): Noting customer-facing message draft: "We're seeing intermittent outbound connectivity in eu-west-2; engineering is investigating and mitigation underway. We'll update in 15 minutes." Want me to post?
Maria (oncall): Yes, please post the status page and send to the affected customers list. Mark impact as: degraded outbound for some customers, partial API failures. ETA initial mitigation: ~5m.
SRE Handoff Bot: :information_source: Handoff created: `incident/3301234567` assigned to oncall-sre for 2h follow-up. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/3301234567/handoff
Jamie (sre): Metrics: proxy error rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in the 5m after the route flip back. Latency normalized for most flows. Still seeing a few retries from long-lived connections.
Ashok (netops): I'm running a quick conntrack cleanup on a handful of affected NAT instances to clear established-but-broken mappings:```bash
for i in $(aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=tag:Name,Values=nat-abc123" --query "Reservations[].Instances[].InstanceId" --output text); do ssh nat@$i "sudo conntrack -F"; done
```
Ashok (netops): cleanup done at 3301234580.
Alex (support): Customer update posted and support triage teams told to reopen any tickets if errors persist. Two customers reported restored traffic within 3 minutes post-mitigation; two still seeing intermittent 502s but reduced frequency.
Maria (oncall): Marking current state: mitigated -> egress largely restored, partial impact lingering. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then handoff to next oncall for RCA.
Jamie (sre): Captured packet traces show asymmetric path prior to fix: SYNs from app -> internet NAT-def456, responses returned to NAT-abc123. After replace-route, symmetric. Saving traces to /shared/incidents/3301234567/pcap.tar.gz
Ashok (netops): Root cause note (initial): automated route reconciliation job introduced a route mapping patch that selected NAT by tag precedence; tag mislabel caused cross-AZ selection. I've disabled the job's production rollouts and created a rollback PR: https://git.redwood/repo/networking/changes/2142
Maria (oncall): Next steps: - keep monitoring for 30m - run scheduled audit of route-table tags in eu-west-2 - coordinate RCA writeup and postmortem if customer impact confirmed > 10 customers or > 30m impact.
SRE Handoff Bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff updated: monitoring period ends at 3301236367. Assigned to Jamie (sre) for postmortem.
Alex (support): I'll update affected tickets with final note: mitigation performed by netops (route replace), follow-up RCA scheduled.
Jamie (sre): Quick note for postmortem: collect `aws config` history for rtb-0a1b2c3d, route-change events, and the route-reconcile job logs. Also correlate with deploy window at 3301234200 - looks like the automated job window.
Maria (oncall): Thanks team. Filing incident record and initial impact summary. Closing Slack triage thread but keeping handoff open for RCA. :thumbsup:
